warnings: op1 direct read (house 13, Stage-2 SN-EE-M agent). First of 2 mechanical sheets (M-01 of 2) -- together with M-02 (page 66) covers this house's full ventilation-fan/AC layout, split by floor same as the electrical lighting/outlet plans. Sheet title only mentions 'พัดลมระบายอากาศ' (ventilation fans), no AC units on this floor -- matches houses 04/10's equivalent M-01 (ground floor has no bedrooms, so no wall-type AC here; AC units are all on M-02's upper floor).

Only 2 ventilation devices total on this floor (1 kitchen propeller fan + 1 ground-floor bathroom ceiling-fan/grille pair) -- same count and layout as house #4's/#10's equivalent M-01 sheet for this house series, consistent with a small ground floor with no bedrooms.

Underlying room/grid drawing on this sheet is printed in a faint/light line weight (a 'recommended position' overlay on top of the architectural floor plan, per the sheet's own 'ที่แนะนำ' (recommended) title) while only the 2 mechanical fixtures and their callout boxes are printed bold -- room names/grid transcribed from the faint layer with slightly lower confidence than a normal plan sheet.

GRID CAVEAT: the printed dimension chain on this faint overlay reads '1.10 / 3.50 / 3.00' with a partially-cropped final tick near the right edge, and a separate '6.50' overall figure -- this does not cleanly resolve against the authoritative grid master (x: 1'=-1.10, 1=0, 2=3.50, 3=7.00, 3'=8.10, confirmed from the S-04/S-05 structural beam plans). Since this M-sheet is an explicitly non-binding 'แนะนำ' (recommended) overlay and the fixtures shown are not themselves dimensioned to any grid line, grid_ref values here are approximate room-based (~) reads against the master, and the sheet's own printed dimension chain is not used for span/position math -- consistent with the standing rule that structural S-sheets, not M/E overlays, govern grid geometry.

element_type 'accessory' used for the propeller fan and exhaust grille (neither is a ceiling fan) since no more specific canonical §0.4 value fits a wall/duct-mounted ventilation fan or grille; 'ceiling_fan' (core list) used only for the actual ceiling-mounted fan unit.
